text:
maria: FYI I generated an incident heatmap for the last 6 months (prod only). Pulled tags from postmortems + oncall notes. Dashboard: https://rdw.in/heatmap-6m
ashwin: great — any obvious clusters?
maria: yep — three clear hotspots: 1) cache/KV eviction cascades, 2) model timeout fallbacks not configured, 3) infra autoscaler oscillation on Dedicated pools. Each shows up in ~35-45% of multi-incident sequences.
leigh: do we have a list of the specific incidents feeding those categories?
analytics-bot: linked incidents for "KV-eviction": 1763723456, 1773007890, 1779004567. linked incidents for "timeout-fallback": 1768504321, 1773007890.
sam: can we map customer impact (SLO blow vs degraded) per cluster? that changes remediation priority.
analytics-bot: KV-eviction -> majority degraded (<1% SLO breach), autoscaler -> intermittent SLO breaches, fallback -> higher SLO breach rate. see heatmap legend.
nashwin: proposed quick wins: (A) enforce conservative cache-admission policy, (B) enable model fallback chain for systems without it, (C) tune autoscaler cooldowns + add rate-limiter for bursty inference.
devon: for (B) we already have a partial fallback SDK but it's not enabled by default for many Hosted routes. I can enable as a canary for 2 low-traffic models this week.
leigh: ownership/ETAs? I want these in the postmortem follow-ups list so they don't fall through.
maria: draft action items below — please ack and update ETA if needed.
  - ACTION 1: Cache admission policy review + conservative defaults. Owner: @ashwin. ETA: 2026-04-20. Rationale: reduces KV eviction cascades that trigger cold-start spikes.
  - ACTION 2: Enable model fallback chain by default for hosted routes + add test harness. Owner: @devon. ETA: 2026-04-10 (canary), full roll 2026-04-30.
  - ACTION 3: Autoscaler tuning: increase cooldown to 120s, add smoothing window, add circuit-breaker for bursty requests. Owner: @sam. ETA: 2026-04-25.
  - ACTION 4: Postmortem template update to include "recurrence flag" + tagging to make heatmap generation easier. Owner: @leigh. ETA: 2026-04-07.
ops-bot: NOTE: incident 1773007890 currently has pending action item "KV eviction runbook" assigned to ashwin.
nashwin: acked. I'll add a short runbook snippet to the infra-runbooks repo and link it.
maria: also recommending monthly incident hygiene sweep — 1-hr monthly sync to close stale postmortem items and reconcile ownership. Thoughts?
devon: yes, good idea. Would be helpful to have a triage board view (kanban) filtered by "recurrence".
leigh: I'll add that to the SRE board and create a recurring 1-hr event: "Incident hygiene — recurring patterns" (first session 2026-04-12).
sam: small ask — when you write the remediation tasks into the board, add expected rollbacks and measurable success criteria (eg: reduce cascading evictions by X% or reduce SLO breaches by Y).
maria: noted. I'll add measurable KPIs to each action and follow up after the first month of changes.
analytics-bot: scheduled: generate updated heatmap snapshot after 2026-05-01 to measure impact.
maria: thanks everyone. I'll consolidate these into the follow-up tracker and ping owners with reminders. If you want a quick sync, 30m tomorrow 1pm PT works for me.
devon: 1pm PT works.
nashwin: works for me.
leigh: +1.
sam: +1.
maria: closing thread for now — will update thread_ts when I post the consolidated tracker. :spiral_calendar_pad:
